title: 第15章 放开那个修女让我来第16章 大杀四方
slug: 转生反派贵族妈妈们都太爱我了

黑鸦镇。
这里的空气混杂着硫磺与腐烂木材的气息，吸进肺里有种砂砾磨损气管的粗粝感。
最后一匹战马在踏入镇界石的那一刻前蹄折断，由于长途奔袭导致的肌肉溶解，这牲口甚至没来得及发出一声嘶鸣，就闷头栽倒在泥泞中。
肖恩从马背上跃下，靴底踩在黑褐色的土地上，发出粘稠的声音。
他避开了镇上零星的居民，这些被贫穷与绝望折磨得形同枯木的人，并没有察觉到这个不速之客。
肖恩凭借脑海中那段名为堕落圣女的cg记忆，轻车熟路地穿过几条狭窄的巷弄。
镇北尽头，一座半塌陷的教堂突兀地立在缓坡上。
大面积的石砖剥落，露出里面发黑的木质结构。
教堂外的空地上，十几具身着白袍的修士尸体被随意堆叠，血液早已干涸成暗紫色，招引来成群的食腐蝇，嗡鸣声吵得人心烦。
外围，几个披着深紫长袍，兜帽压得很低的家伙正百无聊赖地巡视。
他们手里拎着铭刻了扭曲符文的长柄镰刀。
肖恩伏在一处残破的石墙后，眼神锁定在教堂那扇虚掩的橡木大门上。
硬闯不是最优解。
这群邪教徒虽然单体实力普通，但最擅长死灵咒术和这种防不胜防的毒素。
他需要保存体力应对里面的情况。
他利用自身敏捷性，避开对方视线死角，整个人贴在潮湿的石壁边缘，顺着教堂侧面破碎的彩绘玻璃窗翻了进去。
脚尖落地无声。
内部的景象比外面更加压抑。
原本供奉神祇的圣坛被捣毁，取而代之的是一个用暗红液体绘就的逆五芒星阵。

正中央的受刑架上，一个女人被粗大的铁链锁住了四肢。
那是伊莎贝拉。
身穿修女服。
她的长发被汗水粘在脸颊上，眼眸半睁，透出一种近乎涣散的哀戚。
圣母般的面庞与此刻悲惨的处境交织出一种极具冲击力的残缺美。
在受刑架下方，站着三个身形佝偻的祭司，他们手中的刻刀正滴落着某种泛着荧光的紫色药液。
“大功告成，这个淫魔纹终于雕刻完成。”
为首的祭司发出一阵嘶哑的干笑。
“真是不容易，圣愈之源的抗性比预想中强得多。”另一个祭司盯着那诡异的纹路，语气里满是狂热。
“只要这个女人产生一点点邪念，淫魔纹就会强行扭曲她的圣力，让她不停地分泌母乳。”
“到了那时候，这种高浓度的神性能量，将成为我们献祭给亡灵之主的最好祭品。”
那个首领嘿嘿笑着，指尖已经触碰到了伊莎贝拉的皮肤，“有了这淫魔纹，她根本控制不住内心的邪念。”
“所谓的高洁，在绝对的生理支配面前，不过是块可以随意涂抹的白布。”
“哦，对了，再加一些催情粉，效果肯定不错。”
“让我先来看看，这具被神祝福过的身体，现在究竟变得有多敏感。”
伊莎贝拉的身体猛地蜷缩了一下，铁链在寂静的教堂内发出刺耳的碰撞声。
她的嘴唇被咬出了血，喉咙里发出压抑的呜咽。
“别急，我的圣女大人。”

Black Crow Town.
The air here is mixed with the smell of sulfur and rotten wood, and when you inhale it, there is a rough feeling in your lungs, like grit abrading your trachea.
The last war horse's front hooves were broken the moment it stepped into the boundary stone. Due to the muscle dissolution caused by the long-distance running, the animal didn't even have time to neigh and fell down in the mud.
Sean jumped off the horse, and the soles of his boots made a sticky sound on the dark brown earth.
He avoided the scattered residents of the town, who were reduced to dead trees by poverty and despair, and did not notice this uninvited guest.
Sean relied on the CG memory called the Fallen Saint in his mind to walk through several narrow alleys with ease.
At the northern end of the town, a half-collapsed church stood abruptly on a gentle slope.
Large areas of stone bricks peeled off, revealing the blackened wooden structure inside.
In the open space outside the church, more than a dozen corpses of monks in white robes were piled up randomly. The blood had long dried into dark purple, attracting swarms of carrion flies, and the buzzing sound was annoying.
On the periphery, several guys wearing dark purple robes and hoods pulled down were patrolling boredly.
In their hands they carried scythes engraved with twisted runes.
Sean crouched behind a broken stone wall, his eyes locked on the ajar oak door of the church.
Breaking in by force is not the optimal solution.
Although this group of cultists have average individual strength, they are best at necromancy spells and this kind of toxin that is difficult to prevent.
He needed to conserve his energy to deal with the situation inside.
He used his agility to avoid the blind spot of the opponent's sight, stuck his whole body on the edge of the damp stone wall, and climbed in along the broken stained glass window on the side of the church.
The toes hit the ground silently.
The scene inside is even more depressing than outside.
The altar originally dedicated to the gods was destroyed and replaced by an inverse pentagram array painted with dark red liquid.
On the torture rack in the center, a woman's limbs were locked with thick iron chains.
That's Isabella.
Wearing a nun's uniform.
Her long hair was stuck to her cheeks with sweat, and her eyes were half-opened, revealing an almost distracted sadness.
The Virgin-like face and the tragic situation at this moment interweave a kind of impactful incomplete beauty.
Under the torture rack, stood three rickety priests, with some kind of fluorescent purple liquid dripping from the knives in their hands.
"It's done, this obscene demon pattern is finally carved."
The leading priest let out a hoarse dry laugh.
"It's really not easy. The resistance of the source of holy healing is much stronger than expected." Another priest stared at the strange lines, his tone full of fanaticism.
"As long as this woman has a little evil thought, the obscene demon pattern will forcibly distort her holy power and make her secrete breast milk continuously."
"At that time, this high concentration of divine energy will become our best sacrifice to the Lord of the Dead."
The leader chuckled, his fingertips already touching Isabella's skin, "With these obscene demon marks, she can't control the evil thoughts in her heart at all."
"The so-called nobility, in the face of absolute physiological control, is nothing more than a white cloth that can be applied at will."
"Oh, by the way, if you add some aphrodisiac powder, the effect will definitely be good."
"Let me first see how sensitive this body that has been blessed by God has become."
Isabella's body curled up suddenly, and the chains made a harsh collision sound in the silent church.
Her lip was bitten with blood, and a suppressed sob came from her throat.
"Don't worry, my holy lady."
